# Available Resources

*Javascript:* [CryptoJS](https://code.google.com/archive/p/crypto-js/), [JSCL](http://bitwiseshiftleft.github.io/sjcl/)

*Swift:* [CryptoSwift](https://cryptoswift.io/), [RNCryptor](https://github.com/RNCryptor/RNCryptor)

*Java,Scala:* [JCE](https://docs.oracle.com/javase//1.5.0/docs/guide/security/jce/JCERefGuide.html), [NaCl](https://nacl.cr.yp.to/), [Commons Crypto](https://commons.apache.org/proper/commons-crypto/)

*C++:* [NaCl](https://nacl.cr.yp.to/), [Botan](https://botan.randombit.net/)

*PHP:* [OpenSSL](https://www.openssl.org/)

*Android:* 
[Libsodium (lazysodium)](https://doc.libsodium.org/)
